source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Pumpkin Post and Banana Beat Newsletters, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: mini baguette or Italian bread, about 9 inches long, split lengthwise, or 2 split English muffins
part-skim mozzarella or cheddar cheese, shredded

steps.instruction: Toast the bread until slightly brown.
Top the bread with 1/2 cup of pizza sauce.
Add 1/4 cup of chopped green pepper and 1/4 cup of sliced mushrooms.
Top with 1/2 cup of shredded cheese.
Sprinkle with Italian seasoning, if you like.
Return the bread to a toaster oven, or a regular oven preheated to 350 °F.
